title: ISO-NE Argues Transitional Cluster Costs Fair, Cites Shrinking Headroom

meta.summary:
ISO-NE defended its cluster study methodology and argued that the high network upgrade cost estimates stemmed from shrinking headroom on its transmission system. 
 The post  ISO-NE Argues Transitional Cluster Costs Fair, Cites Shrinking Headroom  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
